newsitem.title: USA: Startronix unaware bank accounts frozen.
newsitem.headline: Startronix unaware bank accounts frozen.

text.p: Startronix International Inc said on Friday that it was unaware its bank accounts had been frozen by a temporary restraining order.
"Our bank account has not been frozen," said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Greg Gilbert. "It is a totally inaccurate and false statement that a judge ordered our bank account frozen."
The company's placement agent, Baytree Associates, said Friday Startronix's bank accounts were ordered frozen and a group of investors filed suit against company claiming fraud.

The agent said the suit was filed because when investors in Startronix's recent private placement submitted their Series C convertible preferred shares for conversion into common stock, the company refused.

Startronix said it suspended conversion of the preferred, issued in a Regulation S private placement, because of "concerted market irregularities in the trading of its common stock which management believes is related to the conversion terms of such Regulation S Private Placement."
Gilbert said, "Management believes this action is in the best interest of the company and its shareholders."
Startronix also said it had not been served any notice that a lawsuit had been filed against it.
Startronix markets technologies and Internet-related products and services to consumers and home-based business owners.
